_comment: Savings of one won bet, per chore (docs/discovery/product-concept.md, Chore catalogue). 'sourced' figures link their source; the rest are labelled 'typical estimate'. Time counts skipped steps only: hanging laundry instead of the dryer is 0 minutes.

plants.assumption: 5 balcony pots: about 4 L of watering and 5 min skipped

heat-pump.assumption: vs a heat-pump dryer, ~2.2 kWh per load; no minutes saved

condenser.assumption: vs a condenser dryer, ~3.5 kWh per load; no minutes saved

vented.assumption: vs a vented dryer, ~5.3 kWh per load; no minutes saved

none.assumption: no dryer in your baseline, so no electricity saved and no minutes

laundry_tonight.assumption: about 10 min of bringing laundry in and ~1.5 kWh of rack or dryer skipped

ac.assumption: ~2.5 kWh of air conditioning per evening skipped, no minutes

heater.assumption: ~3.5 kWh of heating per day skipped, no minutes
